notes: Verifier K, wave 4. Printed: 'Vigilance, reach, trample / Whenever this creature attacks or blocks, choose one - Create a 3/3 green Beast creature token. / You gain 3 life. / Draw a card.' Expectation from the text: on the opponent's turn their 2/2 flier attacks; reach lets Gargaroth block it (CR 702.17b); blocking triggers the choose-one, and choosing the second mode gains its controller 3 life (20 -> 23) and creates no Beast; the flier dies to 6 damage.
